verdict.rationale: Canny documents its own changelog product for announcing shipped updates, and separately documents embedding 'a Canny widget' into websites and mobile apps. Nothing in the evidence shows that the embeddable widget actually displays the changelog in-product rather than only the feedback board, so the embedded-changelog part of the story is unproven. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an embeddable changelog widget (in-app display, install snippet, unread or notification behavior), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can showcase new updates within my product using an embeddable changelog widget

citations.quote: Announce what you shipped, show customers you heard them, and turn closed feedback into retention and upgrades.
